title: Preserve remote transport status array identity when state adoption has equal values
outcome: Full-state and diff adoption avoid scheduling root App state changes solely because equal remote transport status arrays were parsed anew.
acceptance: Equal remote transport status values retain the previously adopted array identity, including the empty or absent case.
Changed remoteId, code, stale, detail or recoveryAction values still reach the App consumer.
Behavioural coverage distinguishes equal repeated adoption from a changed status without pinning implementation text.
